paper_title: 高速公路应急车道启用管控优化与决策模型研究

argumentation_roles.role: Q1 data extraction and descriptive evidence
argumentation_roles.lesson: Show the raw-video → track/count → physical/proxy quantity conversion before any forecast. Put frame/time conversion and units on the figure, not only in prose.

argumentation_roles.role: Q1 model comparison and congestion evidence
argumentation_roles.lesson: Model-comparison figures should use a leakage-safe chronological holdout and aligned timestamps. Replace cherry-picked positive frames by an event-level validation panel including misses and false alarms.

argumentation_roles.role: Q2/Q3 multi-point relationship and policy evidence
argumentation_roles.lesson: Correlation heatmaps support association only. If a rule changes the plotted series by fixed multipliers, label the plot “scenario assumption/sensitivity” rather than “observed intervention effect”.

argumentation_roles.role: Q4 sensing geometry and placement evidence
argumentation_roles.lesson: A placement section should progress geometry/calibration → objective/constraints → candidate-location search → coverage/cost/uncertainty tradeoff. A binary-search illustration alone is not an optimization proof.

style_learning_boundary: Current worktree has indexed text but not mounted original S017 PDF pixels; no claim is made about exact colors/fonts/line widths/layout. Only figure count, captions/context and argumentative sequence are learned.
